decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful Eldrazi creatures. It includes cards that help search for lands and generate extra mana, along with Eldrazi Temple to accelerate the process. The goal is to control the game using powerful creature spells like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, while also disrupting the opponent with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats while maintaining control of the game through resource management and strategic play.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures and cards that put cards into the graveyard to fill up the graveyard quickly. This leads to the ability to cast Living End, which allows the player to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, giving them a significant advantage over their opponent. The deck also includes counter spells to protect the combo and various creatures with cycling abilities to dig for combo pieces. The goal is to set up a powerful board state that overwhelms the opponent and secures a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also controlling the board with disruptive cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon. It utilizes powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to push for damage and close out the game quickly. The mana base is built to support a fast and consistent curve, with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure smooth mana production. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt provide reach and removal to deal with threats and secure victory.

The deck aims to leverage the combo potential of Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to quickly mill cards from the opponent's library and ultimately win the game through alternate win conditions such as Thassa's Oracle or Malevolent Rumble. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help recur key combo pieces from the graveyard, while Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble provide additional mana ramp and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat offer some disruption and removal options, making the deck versatile and capable of adapting to different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to build a fast and aggressive Boros Aggro strategy, focusing on quickly overwhelming the opponent with high-powered creatures and burn spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, Lightning Bolt, and Bonecrusher Giant, along with support from static prison and goblin Bombardment, this deck aims to control the battlefield and deal damage swiftly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds versatility and a potential late-game advantage. The deck's consistency and synergy make it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removal, and card advantage. The key concept revolves around using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push, countering key spells with cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation, and generating card advantage through cards like Archmage's Charm and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes disruption elements like Sink into Stupor and Toxic Deluge to control the board state. Overall, the strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage to secure a win.

The main theme of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Arena of Glory and Static Prison to control the board and protect its creatures. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion that can provide additional value in the late game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and finish them off with burn spells for a swift victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and control spells to slow down the opponent's game plan while assembling the powerful combo of The One Ring and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. The key concept revolves around creating a lock on the opponent's resources and denying them the ability to effectively play spells, ultimately leading to victory through superior board control. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent by leveraging the synergies between artifacts, card draw, and disruptive elements to maintain a dominant position in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the "Living End" sorcery card to return all creature cards from the players' graveyard to the battlefield. By cycling through cards such as Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures before casting Living End to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden board presence. Cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves help with card draw and tempo, while cards like Architects of Will and Generous Ent provide additional control and disruption. The goal is to execute a powerful combo play to secure victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing a variety of creatures with unique abilities to assemble a winning combination. By tutoring for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician for value, the deck aims to generate incremental advantages and overwhelm the opponent with a versatile toolbox of creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Fulminator Mage and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and creature manipulation. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Force of Negation, Fatal Push, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining card advantage with cards like Preordain and Cling to Dust. The goal is to gradually gain control of the game and ultimately emerge victorious through strategic play and careful resource management.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mixture of creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes cards that can control the opponent's hand, as well as creatures with powerful abilities and strong stats. The Companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional utility and consistency to the deck. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive strategy while also allowing for flexibility in casting spells of different colors. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a variety of spells and abilities, with a particular emphasis on disrupting the opponent's strategy. It utilizes counterspells, removal spells, and cards that can manipulate the game state such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Dress Down. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and resource advantage through cards like Nulldrifter and Tune the Narrative. Overall, the goal is to outmaneuver the opponent and establish a dominant position on the battlefield with cards like The One Ring and Wrath of the Skies.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with cascade mechanics, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea, the deck can continually cascade into more spells, generating value and tempo advantage. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help control the board, while cards like Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco provide formidable threats that can quickly close out the game. By balancing speed, versatility, and disruptive elements, this deck aims to outpace and overcome opponents in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures to control the game while ramping up mana to play powerful threats like Emrakul. The synergy between cards like Eldrazi Temple and Malevolent Rumble allows for early aggression while cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and World Breaker provide late game stability. By using ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse, the deck can quickly accelerate its mana base to cast devastating spells like Emrakul, the Promised End. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while overwhelming them with powerful Eldrazi creatures.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies, utilizing strong creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and protect your creatures. The deck's mana base is built to support its aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion adds an additional powerful threat to the deck's strategy.
